{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not real revenue)
real_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if the dataset contains the claimed three channels
print('Channels present in the data:', real_orders['channel'].unique())

# Compute total revenue by channel
channel_revenue = real_orders.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print('\nTotal revenue by channel:\n', channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]
print('\nChannel with highest total revenue:', best_channel['channel'], '($', best_channel['revenue_clean'], ')')"}
